events.title: South Pole Illuminated Festival
events.blurb: A holiday lights festival on Saturday and Sunday evenings.
events.blurbEs: Un festival de luces navideñas el sábado y el domingo por la tarde.

events.title: McAllen Public Library
events.blurb: An award-winning library built inside a former Walmart, with a big kids’ area.
events.blurbEs: Una biblioteca premiada construida dentro de un antiguo Walmart, con una gran zona infantil.

events.title: Quinta Mazatlán
events.blurb: A 1930s adobe estate with trails through native thorn forest; good birding.
events.blurbEs: Una hacienda de adobe de los años 30 con senderos por el bosque nativo; ideal para ver aves.
